name: @red-cup-engineering/serve-oauth-metadata-service
description: Turn an authorization server's config into its two discovery documents: the RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata document, and the RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata document for one protected resource. Use it to serve /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource(/*).
